heading: THE EPISTLE OF IGNATIUS TO HERO, A DEACON OF ANTIOCH.
paragraphs:
Ignatius, who is also called Theophorus, to Hero,
the deacon of Christ, and the servant of God, a
man honoured by God, and most dearly loved as
well as esteemed, who carries Christ and the Spirit
within him, and who is mine own son in faith and love: Grace,
mercy, and peace from Almighty God, and from Christ Jesus
our Lord, His only-begotten Son, “who gave Himself for our
sins, that He might deliver us from the present evil world,”[1901]
and preserve us unto His heavenly kingdom.
